title: WabbleSpec recipe.json
description: Declared build target for the current session. Written by Recipe. Read by all downstream modules.

target.description: Primary declared build target for this session. Locked after Recipe runs.

confidence.description: Detection confidence. Must be ≥ 0.8 for auto-declare. Below 0.8 requires user confirmation.

complexity.description: Task complexity. Low = single feature, no integration points. Medium = multiple components, 1-2 integration points. High = cross-cutting or unclear.

secondary_targets.description: Additional targets present (monorepo case). Empty array if single target.

collapse_eligible.description: true only when complexity=Low AND single spec stage AND I2 gate collapsing is permitted.

locked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when recipe was declared.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Used to detect stale recipe.json from prior sessions.
